english: All the distinct words (with or without meaning) obtained by arranging the six letters of the word PEPPER are listed in dictionary order. One of these words is chosen at random. Let $p$ be the probability that the chosen word comes before PEPPER in the list and $q$ the probability that it comes after PEPPER. Then the value of $p-q$ is ______.
hindi: शब्द PEPPER के छः अक्षरों को व्यवस्थित करके प्राप्त सभी भिन्न शब्दों (अर्थपूर्ण अथवा अर्थहीन) को शब्दकोश क्रम में सूचीबद्ध किया जाता है। इनमें से एक शब्द यादृच्छया चुना जाता है। माना कि $p$ चुने गए शब्द के सूची में PEPPER से पहले आने की प्रायिकता है तथा $q$ उसके PEPPER के बाद आने की प्रायिकता है। तब $p-q$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Before PEPPER: E-----: $\dfrac{5!}{3!}=20$; PEE---: $\dfrac{3!}{2!}=3$; PEPE--: $2!=2$; then PEPPER itself
solution_full: PEPPER has the letters $E,E,P,P,P,R$, so the number of distinct words is $N=\dfrac{6!}{2!\,3!}=60$. In dictionary order $E<P<R$.
Words beginning with E: the other letters $E,P,P,P,R$ give $\dfrac{5!}{3!}=20$ words, all before PEPPER.
Words beginning with P: next letter E (as in PEPPER). Third letter E: PEE followed by $P,P,R$ gives $\dfrac{3!}{2!}=3$ words, all before PEPPER.

Third letter P (as in PEPPER): fourth letter E gives PEPE followed by $P,R$, i.e. 2 words, before PEPPER; fourth letter P gives PEPP followed by $E,R$: PEPPER, PEPPRE, and PEPPER is the first of these.
So $25$ words precede PEPPER and its rank is $r=26$; the number of words after it is $60-26=34$.
originality_note: New: the rank of a word with repeated letters, converted into the difference of 'before' and 'after' probabilities (2r - N - 1)/N, which is exact to two decimals only because N = 60 (way 5: rank and permutations of alike objects linked through a probability). Closest known: 'rank of the word ... among the arrangements of its letters'. Different because: both the rank and the total with repetitions are needed, and the answer is their signed combination.
